true_answer: philosophers believe that the universe was inﬁnite, and was an illusion to humans.[70]Plato believed that time was made by the Creator at the same instant as the heavens.[70] He also says that time is a period of motion of the heavenly bodies.[70] Aristotle believed that time correlated to movement, that time did not exist on its own but was relative to motion of objects.
